questions.question: How should these recovered summaries look in the conversation?

options.label: Muted note (Recommended)
options.description: Shown in the reply, slightly dimmer and italic, so you can tell it's Claude Code's short summary rather than the full reply. Safe if a model ever stores real reasoning there.
